main.description: One mailbox epoch (SPEC §5). rkey = epochNumber zero-padded to 12 digits; creating an existing rkey fails with RecordAlreadyExists, which is the race guard between devices ([CB-9]). Immutable once written.

encryptedPreviousEpochNumber.description: encrypt(epochDataStorageKey, 'epoch_data_metadata', decimal(prev seq)). Absent for epoch 0.

encryptedPreviousEpochRootKey.description: encrypt(epochDataStorageKey, 'epoch_data_metadata', prev root). Absent for epoch 0.

openedBy.description: deviceKeyPubkey of the device that opened the epoch (its epochStorageAuthKey authenticates the entropy).
